test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: TN 14 is related to PK 29 in a certain way. In the same way, JD 3 is related to FA 18. To which of the given options is SG -5 related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The pattern consists of two parts:

 
• **Letter Shift:** The first letter is shifted backward by 4 positions, and the second letter is shifted backward by 3 positions.
 
• **Number Shift:** The number is increased by 15.

Applying the logic to the given pairs:

**TN 14 is related to PK 29**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee6595255a3a04c08fcc316f26c0360afc0a8e07a6a58340280a81f3507baf59.png] 

**JD 3 is related to FA 18**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5dd28224faf6b8c205572c5d4d3df55e1bae0e32e136f57e78aa6166db876363.png] 

Applying the logic to SG -5:

**SG -5 is related to what?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e8bb16e0994e5ad934363ac00b896a7d14ef63f1db6e97cb4608c5820000163.png] 

Following this logic, SG -5 is related to **OD 10**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
